en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 160 - Saad bin Abdullah has narrated from Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid from Yunus bin Abdur Rahman from Husain bin Thuwair bin Abi Fakhta from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:
After Hasan and Husain, Imamate will never come to two brothers because after Ali Ibn Husain, Imamate is only in his progeny, generation after generation.
